_doc: Branches that linger are not a tidiness problem. Real unmerged work gets
buried in them. This checks for branches whose content is genuinely not
on the main line, and for worktrees left checked out.
exempt_branches takes a reason, not just a name. Write what must NOT be
merged from it, so the next person does not merge the whole thing.

exempt_branches.name: spike/new-parser
exempt_branches.do_not_merge: The vendored parser fork in third_party/. Only the benchmark script is worth keeping.
